Hi Sarah — thanks for the clear list. Short answers up front, then a proposed plan: 

1) Latest report: attached (Redwood_SOC2_TypeII_2024.pdf). Coverage period: 2024-12-01 through 2025-11-30 (Type II).
2) Bridge coverage: yes — we can provide a signed bridge letter that attests to continued control coverage from 2025-12-01 through your renewal date. Draft attached (bridge_letter_draft.docx).
3) One-paragraph attestation: below — feel free to use this in your PO.

--- Attestation (for procurement) ---
Redwood Inference attests that, subsequent to the period covered by the attached SOC 2 Type II report, the company has maintained materially consistent information security controls related to the scope described in the report and will provide a signed bridge letter to cover the interim period up to the renewal effective date of 2027-01-15.

---

Planned next steps:
- I’ve looped in Monica (security) to finalize the bridge wording and confirm the signatory (CISO or Head of Compliance).
- Karthik, can you confirm whether we need any additional evidence (system architecture diagrams, SIG answers) for procurement to accept the bridge?
- Laura, can you share the DocuSign link / procurement milestone so we can align delivery?

We can turn around a signed bridge within 2 business days after confirming signatory. Let me know if you want the bridge on Redwood letterhead or as a separate attestation PDF.

Best,
